cobblemon.species.warden_boss.name: Warden
cobblemon.species.warden_boss.desc: A guardian that senses everything through vibrations in the deepest darkness.
cobblemon.move.wardenpunch.desc: Swing a powerful fist at the target to deal damage.
cobblemon.move.sonicwave.desc: After a brief charge, it unleashes an unstoppable sonic attack.
cobblemon.move.darksurge.desc: A surge of darkness obscures vision and lowers the accuracy of nearby Pokémon.
cobblemon.move.soniclock.desc: Uses sound waves to pinpoint and lock onto the target.
cobblemon.ability.xice_dark_shroud.desc: Lowers foes' accuracy on entry and grants immunity to paralysis and sleep.
